privacy: Your recording is used only to create your voice.

house.title:
A bedtime story,
in a voice they know.
house.body: Pick a ready-made narrator or add your own voice with a 30 second recording.

voice.title: Let us tell the stories in your voice.
voice.body: Reading aloud for about 30 seconds is enough. On the nights you cannot be there, your child still hears the story in your voice.

sleep.title: A story every night.
sleep.body: Keep the stories you love. Set the sleep timer and playback stops by itself when the story ends.
